title: Stop Hunting for Business Spend Data. Just Ask.
summary: Learn how Model Context Protocol (MCP) securely connects business banking data to AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude so business owners can get clearer financial insights faster.
body_markdown:
#### Summary


Business owners spend too much time gathering financial data—and not enough time using it. With Model Context Protocol (MCP) from First Internet Bank, customers can **choose to securely connect** their First Internet Bank business accounts to AI assistants like OpenAI’s ChatGPT* or Anthropic’s Claude* to ask questions and get real answers instantly. No spreadsheets. No extra tools. Just clearer insights to help you make faster, more confident decisions with your First Internet Bank Business Checking, Business Money Market or Business Savings account.


#### Imagine If Your Finances Could Explain Themselves


No reports to build. No dashboards to navigate. Just answers and insights when you need them. That’s the future of business banking.


At First Internet Bank, we’re introducing a new way for business customers to choose to securely connect their First Internet Bank accounts to OpenAI’s ChatGPT* or Anthropic’s Claude*. It’s powered by[Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://www.firstib.com/business/ai-driven-banking/) , a secure technology that helps your financial data work for you—inside the tools you already use.


##### What is MCP?


MCP is a secure connection **you choose to establish** between your First Internet Bank business account and ChatGPT or Claude. It allows AI to read approved information, like balances and transactions, so it can provide accurate insights.


Key benefits include:


- You stay in control of your data and permissions
- Access is read-only—no changes or transactions
- Your login credentials are never shared


##### From Data to Answers


With MCP, you can simply ask:


- “Where can I potentially reduce expenses?”
- “Based on current trends, where will we end the quarter?”
- “What are the biggest drivers of our spending?”


It’s that easy to get immediate, relevant answers. For a busy business owner, that means less time organizing information and more time making decisions.


##### Designed for How You Work


You may already use AI assistants to plan, write and analyze. Now your financial data can live there too. There’s no new system to learn, just smarter access to your business finances.


##### Designed Around Control


MCP is not about handing over your finances to AI. It is about giving you a better way to understand the information you already have. You remain in control of what data is available. Access is read-only, which means AI can analyze information but cannot move money or change your account. Your online banking credentials are not shared with ChatGPT or Claude.


The result is a more useful connection between your business banking data and the AI tools that are becoming part of everyday work.


Imagine if your bank account could answer your questions? With MCP and First Internet Bank, the future is here.


##### Do More with Your First Internet Bank Business Accounts


First Internet Bank’s Business accounts ([business checking](https://www.firstib.com/business/checking/) ,[business money market](https://www.firstib.com/business/savings/) and[business savings](https://www.firstib.com/business/savings/) ) give business owners the flexibility and control they need. MCP builds on that foundation, helping you turn financial data into actionable insights instantly.


With clearer visibility, you can make confident decisions, spot trends early and focus on growing your business—not managing reports.


##### The Future of Business Banking Is More Conversational


AI is changing how business owners analyze and make decisions. MCP brings your business banking data into that same workflow in a secure, controlled way. This is not about replacing sound financial judgment. It is about making the information behind that judgment easier to access and understand.


##### Traditional Banking Experience vs. MCP-Powered Banking Experience


**Traditional Experience** **MCP-Powered Experience**


Export transactions to a spreadsheet Ask a question in an AI assistant


Review static reports Get dynamic answers based on approved data


Switch between tools Work inside ChatGPT, Claude or another supported AI assistant


Spend time organizing data Spend more time making decisions


Look backward after reports are built Explore cash flow and spending trends in the moment


[Learn More](https://www.firstib.com/business/ai-driven-banking/)


**Available now or Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, as well as ChatGPT Pro, Business and Enterprise plans.*


#### Frequently Asked Questions


##### What is MCP in banking?


MCP in banking refers to a secure connection that allows AI tools to access approved banking information so they can provide insights based on real account data.


##### Can AI make transactions through MCP?


No. The MCP experience described here is read-only, so AI can analyze approved information but cannot move money or make account changes.


##### Which AI tools can use MCP?


AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude, based on supported account and plan availability.


##### Why is MCP useful for business owners?


MCP helps business owners ask questions about cash flow, spending and account activity without exporting data or building manual reports.


##### Is my First Internet Bank account automatically connected to ChatGPT or Claude?


No. The connection is not automatic. Customers must choose to connect their First Internet Bank accounts to supported AI assistants through Model Context Protocol (MCP). If you do not set up a connection, your accounts will remain unchanged and will not be connected to an AI assistant.
